_comment: Public MeshCore routing-scope names the health check recognises on receipts (MESHCORE_REGION_SCOPES_FILE). Copied unchanged from matkam/meshcore-settings data/regions.json (MIT, https://github.com/matkam/meshcore-settings), commit 7ec46658, file dated 2026-10-24: its 3 root names, then its 70 places in tree order. That project calls them a community convention, not a standard; re-copy if the Bay Area settles on other names. Unlisted scoped packets show as 'scoped, name not listed'. Names are public only (no $ private scopes), optional leading #, at most 30 bytes, no spaces. Display only: never affects scoring, observers or the map. Not part of the reseed fingerprint.
